column2: This Sheet prioritizes DEFENSE TEAM composition (from Southeast Asia Server). Due to the nature of Guild Wars, it may be hard to completely show ideal ATTACK teams but here's a general guide:

column6:
● When VS Speed comp (usually Attack/Magic) = Aim to outspeed (especially against Vanessa/Nia) or use a team that can withstand DMG or have sustain
● When facing a team with CC (which usually may have low DMG) = Counter with a full sustain team with High ER and aim to win with higher HP
● Sometimes it takes a mirror to fight a mirror (e.g. Wukong VS Wukong)
● Always be mindful of special effects and effect conditions (e.g. Execution, HP Alteration) = Adjust your ATTACK team positioning and Stats accordingly
● Gears indicated are just a general recommendation. There can also be more strategic sets used (depending on Guild Instruction)
